items.name: NVIDIA
items.representative: Mr. Jensen Huang, Chief Executive Officer
items.contributionEn: NVIDIA contributed USD 10 million to the Prime Minister's Disaster Relief Fund for the 2026 Rasuwa flood. CEO Mr. Jensen Huang contributed USD 10 million — among the largest single personal/corporate gifts to the fund; officially acknowledged by the Finance Minister.
items.contributionNe: NVIDIA ले सन् २०२६ रसुवा बाढीका लागि प्रधानमन्त्री दैवी प्रकोप उद्धार कोषमा USD १ करोड (~रु. १.४ अर्ब) योगदान गर्नुभयो। सीईओ श्री जेन्सेन हुवाङले USD १ करोड योगदान — कोषमा हालसम्मकै ठूला व्यक्तिगत/कर्पोरेट दानमध्ये एक; अर्थमन्त्रीबाट आधिकारिक धन्यवाद।
items.thankyouEn: The Government and people of Nepal extend heartfelt thanks to NVIDIA for standing with the flood-affected families of Rasuwa, Nuwakot and the downstream districts.
items.thankyouNe: नेपाल सरकार र नेपाली जनताले रसुवा, नुवाकोट लगायत बाढी प्रभावित परिवारप्रति NVIDIA को सहयोगका लागि हार्दिक धन्यवाद व्यक्त गर्दछन्।

items.name: Doosan Group

items.contributionEn: The Government of the Republic of Latvia — on a draft order submitted by the Latvian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and approved by the Cabinet of Ministers on 8 September 2026 — provided EUR 100,000 in humanitarian assistance to Nepal to help mitigate the consequences of the Bhote Koshi / Rasuwa floods.
